title: A1 Milestone 10: Review
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has completado el Hito 10. Ahora dominas el Present Perfect, preposiciones de tiempo y lugar, y vocabulario clave de reuniones, correos, presentaciones y llamadas.

parts.visual: Hito 10 cubrió: Present Perfect vs Past Simple (I have finished vs I finished yesterday). Ever y Never (Have you ever...? I have never...). Just, Already, Yet (I have just finished, I have already sent it, Not yet).
parts.audio: Milestone ten covered: Present Perfect versus Past Simple. Ever and Never. Just, Already, and Yet.

parts.visual: Preposiciones: Tiempo (in March, on Monday, at 5 PM). Lugar (in the office, on the desk, at the entrance). Vocabulario: Emails (subject, attachment), Telephone (hold on, speaking), Meetings (agenda, minutes), Presentations (Welcome, let's start).
parts.audio: Prepositions of time and place. And vocabulary for emails, telephone calls, meetings, and presentations.

questions.question: I ____ the new office. It's nice. (He visitado).
Have you ____ been to Tokyo? (¿Alguna vez...?).
I have ____ sent the email. (Hace un momento / Acabo de).
Have you finished the report ____? (¿Ya? - Al final).
I have ____ booked the flight. Don't worry. (Ya).
The manager is ____ the meeting room. (Dentro).
Write the topic in the ____ line. (Asunto).
Please ____ on a moment. (Espere).
questions.explanation: Hold on = esperar en la línea.

questions.question: Did everyone read the meeting ____? (Orden del día).
As you can see on the ____... (Diapositiva).
